Interior Improvements & Refurbishment

Coordination of approved painting, repairs, fittings and refurbishment with vendors and professionals, from scope to handover.

Discuss Your Property WhatsApp Us

The problem this solves

A flat between tenants, or one you have just bought, often needs more than a repair: repainting, a kitchen fix, bathroom re-tiling, new fittings. Running that from abroad means paying for work you cannot see and hoping the schedule holds.

What the service includes

  • Scoping visit with photographs and a written list of proposed work
  • Quotations from vendors or contractors, itemised where possible
  • Schedule and staged approvals for larger jobs
  • Site visits during the work with progress photographs
  • Snag list at completion and follow-up with the vendor until closed
  • Coordination with an interior designer or architect you appoint, if the project needs one

How it works

Scope

What needs doing, what would be nice to do, and what each is likely to cost.

Approve

You approve the scope and quotation. For larger projects, approval is staged by phase.

Execute

Vendors are scheduled and supervised; you receive progress photographs.

Hand over

Completion walk-through, snag list, and final photographs and bills.

What you receive

  • Written scope with quotations
  • Progress updates with photographs
  • Snag list and completion report
  • Bills and warranties from vendors

Limits and exclusions

  • We coordinate; the contract for the work is between the owner and the vendor.
  • Structural changes, approvals from the society or authorities, and design services require the appropriate professionals.
  • Projects are quoted separately from the routine management fee.

Questions about this service

Can you handle a full interior makeover?

We coordinate it. For design-led projects we work alongside an interior designer you choose.

How do payments to contractors work?

Payments go from you to the vendor at agreed milestones. We confirm that each milestone is complete before you release payment.
